predictions.claim: Average cross-entropy loss on the massive text dataset cannot drop below ~1.69 nats, no matter how large the model or dataset.
predictions.speaker: Google DeepMind (cited)
predictions.notes: Empirical extrapolation; testable by future frontier models reporting per-token cross-entropy on a comparable corpus.

predictions.claim: Neural scaling laws will continue to hold predictively for next-token loss as models scale further beyond GPT-4.
predictions.speaker: Welch (paraphrasing field consensus)
predictions.notes: Already held across ~13 orders of magnitude; revisit as GPT-5-class and successor models publish loss curves.

predictions.claim: Specific emergent capabilities (e.g., multi-step reasoning, arithmetic) will remain unpredictable from scaling laws alone, appearing discontinuously rather than smoothly.
predictions.speaker: Welch
predictions.notes: Active research debate — some recent work suggests emergence is partly an artifact of metric choice.
